---
title: "opus"
subtitle: "ICES DATRAS data dictionary and known-issues registry"
---

opus consolidates ICES DATRAS's own field-level metadata — types, units, valid
ranges and codes, plus a growing registry of "ICES documents X, but the
service actually does Y" findings — into two machine-readable YAML
specifications, covering four exchange tables:

- **HH** (Haul Information), **HL** (Length Frequency), **CA** (Catch at
  Age) — primary exchange tables
- **LT** (Litter Assessment) — a hybrid: some novel
  observations, some fields joined in from HH; not purely exchange data in
  the same sense as the other three

The R package around these files is thin tooling only (validation,
curation, no domain QC) — the yaml is the deliverable, independent of R or
any other language. It feeds imbus WP2 (reference specification).
